name: Order History
summary: Passive optionally named native order list composed from canonical Link and Badge while targets own order data, status truth, formatting, navigation, authentication, pagination, and lifecycle.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Conditional native section when label is non-empty or ordinary div when no region name is supplied; owns the named inline-size container.

anatomy.name: items
anatomy.description: Required non-empty native unordered list of complete target-owned order summaries.

anatomy.name: row
anatomy.description: Native list item whose CSS areas arrange one complete order summary without changing DOM reading order.

anatomy.name: number
anatomy.description: Required native canonical Link with descriptive visible localized text and a real target-owned order-detail destination.

anatomy.name: date
anatomy.description: Native time element containing localized visible text and a target-provided machine-readable datetime value.

anatomy.name: status
anatomy.description: Required passive canonical Badge with readable target status text and a target-selected semantic visual projection.

anatomy.name: total
anatomy.description: Required already-formatted target total, isolated bidirectionally in Web markup.

variants.name: default
variants.description: One passive order-history profile; target status taxonomy and Badge projection are not U4 variants.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: One intrinsic container-responsive profile; row-area changes are private composition rather than public size.

states.name: default
states.description: Valid non-empty order collection with optional accessible container name.

states.name: unnamedContainer
states.description: Blank or omitted label uses an ordinary div root without aria-label rather than an unnamed section.

states.name: containerAreas
states.description: Private one-, two-, and four-area layouts follow actual U4 container width while preserving DOM order.

states.name: dependencyInteraction
states.description: Canonical Link owns navigation interaction/focus/motion and canonical Badge owns passive semantic visual variants; U4 does not duplicate them.

states.name: requiredContentOmitted
states.description: The complete renderer is absent when orders is missing, empty, duplicated by identifier, or contains an incomplete record.

behavior.name: optionalNamedContainer
attributes: aria-label only on a section when label is non-empty
behavior.description: A trimmed non-empty label selects a named native section; otherwise U4 remains ordinary grouped flow content.

behavior.name: nativeCollection
behavior.description: Use native ul/li relationships without table/grid roles, roving tabindex, arrow-key handling, or a custom collection widget model.

behavior.name: orderNavigation
behavior.description: Canonical native Link preserves descriptive text, normal Tab/Enter, modified activation, history, and target-owned order-detail navigation.

behavior.name: dateSemantics
behavior.description: Target supplies a conforming machine-readable date/time plus independently localized visible text.

behavior.name: statusProjection
behavior.description: Target preserves authoritative financial and fulfillment facts, authors one truthful localized summary for the readable canonical Badge, and selects an appropriate semantic variant. U4 defines no commerce taxonomy; richer multi-fact status composition belongs outside U4 when one summary is insufficient.

behavior.name: totalFormatting
behavior.description: Target supplies final localized total text and currency/tax/refund precision; U4 only places and bidirectionally isolates it.

behavior.name: externalLifecycle
behavior.description: Authentication, authorization, fetching, sorting, filtering, pagination, loading, empty/error/expired states, live updates, announcements, focus, routes, and analytics remain outside passive U4.

behavior.name: containerResponse
behavior.description: Named inline-size container selects private row areas from actual available width rather than viewport width.

behavior.name: contentResilience
behavior.description: Short, long, localized, bidirectional, unbroken, narrow, and effective-200-percent content wraps without clipping or page-level overflow.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Optional accessible name. A trimmed non-empty value selects section[aria-label]; blank or omitted content selects an ordinary div without region semantics.

properties.name: orders
properties.description: Complete non-empty target-owned native order-list composition. Each authoritative target-formatted item contains one descriptive canonical Link, one semantic date, one readable canonical Badge summary, and one formatted total; record schema, count, order, URLs, financial/fulfillment truth, variants, and formatting remain target-owned.

accessibility: Omit the complete renderer when orders is absent, empty, duplicated by identifier, or contains an incomplete record; targets compose a truthful empty/loading/error alternative outside U4.
Use section[aria-label] only when label is non-empty. With no label, render an ordinary div so optional naming never creates an unnamed section.
Use a native ul/li collection. Do not add role=list, role=table, role=grid, roving tabindex, arrow-key navigation, or a custom keyboard model merely because CSS uses visual areas.
Use one native canonical Link with a real target-owned href and descriptive visible localized label per order; preserve Tab, Enter, modified activation, history, and canonical Link focus behavior.
Use a native time element with target-provided conforming datetime and independently localized visible text.
Expose every order status through readable localized Badge text, never color alone. Static history badges are not live regions.

Preserve financial and fulfillment state as separate authoritative target facts. If one localized Badge summary cannot communicate the required distinctions truthfully, use a richer target composition outside U4 rather than inventing a U4 enum or additional hidden status controls.
Keep number, date, status, and total DOM/reading order stable while CSS rearranges visual areas; isolate already-formatted totals bidirectionally.
Protect order data and detail destinations with target authentication and authorization. Keep fetching, pagination, live updates, errors, announcements, and post-navigation focus outside passive U4.
Allow long/localized and unbroken content, narrow containers, effective 200 percent, forced colors, reduced motion, and theme modes through logical sizing and canonical dependency behavior.

web.notes: Conditional named container and native list implemented with canonical Link/Badge, semantic time, formatted total, intrinsic row areas, zero U4 runtime, and target-owned data/lifecycle.

shopify.notes: Shopify v1 themes use the hosted current-account Order index as an intentional native handoff with no U4 parity claim. Target-controlled full-page extensions or headless storefronts may project authoritative U4 summaries with native components and Customer Account data. Classic Liquid is separately versioned compatibility; copied CSS is not a universal order-history implementation.

react.notes: Render complete target records through native Link/Badge composition; query, router, auth, formatting, status mapping, pagination, feedback, and lifecycle stay external.
